sloka: सर्व भूषण भूषार्हाः किम् अर्थम् न विभूषिताः ।उभौ योग्यौ अहम् मन्ये रक्षितुम् पृथिवीम् इमाम् ॥४-३-१५॥
transliteration: sarva bhūṣaṇa bhūṣārhāḥ kim artham na vibhūṣitāḥ ।ubhau yogyau aham manye rakṣitum pṛthivīm imām ॥4-3-15॥

translations.english: 'To me, you both deserve to rule the entire earth encompassed by seas and forests and adorned with mountains like Vindhya and Meru.
